out.detail: knee injury, did not travel, missed seventh straight game

away.summary: The Islanders (3-3-1) are coming off a 2-1 shootout loss to Ottawa where Semyon Varlamov made 18 saves. They project Ilya Sorokin to start in net with Mathew Barzal (knee) and Alexander Romanov (torn ACL) out. The team has allowed three goals or fewer in five of seven games and has a 2.29 goals-against per game, second best in the NHL.

home.summary: The Maple Leafs (3-3-2) dropped a 5-4 overtime decision to Buffalo despite a 4-2 third-period lead and a hat-trick from Kirill Marchenko. They project Sergei Bobrovsky to start in net with Dakota Joshua (core), Max Domi (undisclosed), and Chris Tanev (upper body) out. Auston Matthews has a six-game point streak with 13 points and leads the team in goals (6), assists (7), and points (13).
